name: JavaScript & TypeScript Language Features
author: Cosmic IDE
description: Language intelligence for JavaScript and TypeScript powered by TypeScript Language Server.
detailedDescription:
## JavaScript & TypeScript language support

Edit modern JavaScript and TypeScript projects with fast, IDE-quality language intelligence powered by **typescript-language-server**.

### Features

- Intelligent code completion
- Real-time diagnostics and error reporting
- Go to Definition, Find References, and Rename Symbol
- Signature Help, Hover, and Inlay Hints
- JSX and TSX support
- JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern ECMAScript support

### Supported Languages

- JavaScript (.js, .mjs, .cjs)
- JSX (.jsx)
- TypeScript (.ts, .mts, .cts)
- TSX (.tsx)

### Setup

After installing the plugin, run **Install Web related packages** to install Node.js, TypeScript, and the TypeScript Language Server.

name: Rust Support
author: Cosmic IDE
description: Rust code intelligence, Cargo project creation, and essential build, run, and test workflows.
detailedDescription:
## Rust development

Build and maintain Cargo projects with rust-analyzer code intelligence and integrated Cargo workflows.

### Features

- Completion, diagnostics, navigation, refactoring, and inline assistance from **rust-analyzer**
- Automatic detection of projects containing `Cargo.toml`
- Binary and library project templates
- Cargo actions for fetching dependencies, checking, building, running, and testing

### Setup

After installation, run **Install Rust toolchain** once. Existing Cargo projects are recognized when you open their project directory.

name: Java Support
author: Cosmic IDE
description: Java code intelligence powered by Eclipse JDT LS.
detailedDescription:
## Java development

Build and maintain Java projects with code intelligence powered by Eclipse JDT Language Server.

### Features

- Completion, diagnostics, navigation, refactoring, code actions, and inline assistance from **Eclipse JDT LS**
- Support for Java source files and common JVM project structures
- Automatic integration with Gradle and Maven projects
- Signature help, inlay hints, formatting, and import organization

### Setup

After installation, run **Install JDT LS** once. Java support becomes available when you open a project containing Java source files.

name: Gleam Support
author: Cosmic IDE
description: Gleam code intelligence, project templates, and complete build and package workflows.
detailedDescription:
## Gleam development

Create and maintain Gleam applications and libraries with language intelligence and integrated Gleam tooling.

### Features

- Completion, diagnostics, navigation, and inline assistance from **gleam lsp**
- Automatic detection of projects containing `gleam.toml`
- Project templates for Erlang and JavaScript targets
- Actions for checking, compiling, running, testing, formatting, and dependency updates
- Organized workflows for documentation, exports, fixes, and package publishing

### Setup

After installation, run **Install Gleam** once. Existing Gleam projects are recognized when you open their project directory.

name: Go Support
author: Cosmic IDE
description: Go syntax highlighting, module templates, and build, run, test, and dependency workflows.
detailedDescription:
## Go development

Work with Go modules and workspaces using syntax highlighting, project templates, and integrated Go commands.

### Features

- TextMate syntax highlighting for `.go` files
- Automatic detection of `go.mod` modules and `go.work` workspaces
- Application and library project templates
- Actions for building, running, testing, formatting, and vetting packages
- Organized module, testing, and maintenance workflows

### Setup

After installation, run **Install Go** once. Existing modules and workspaces are recognized when you open their project directory.

name: Gradle Support
author: Cosmic IDE
description: Gradle project templates, automatic detection, runnable applications, and comprehensive build and task workflows.
detailedDescription:
## Gradle development

Create and maintain Gradle builds with integrated lifecycle, dependency, and custom task workflows.

### Features

- Automatic detection of projects containing Gradle wrapper or build files
- Java, Kotlin, Groovy, and Scala project templates
- Toolbar run actions for detected entry points
- Common build, test, and run commands
- A searchable Gradle task picker with all available tasks
- Support for both Gradle wrapper (./gradlew) and system Gradle

### Setup

After installation, run **Install Gradle** once. Gradle projects are recognized when you open a directory containing `gradlew`, `build.gradle`, or `build.gradle.kts`. Uses Cosmic IDE's selected JDK.

name: Lua Support
author: Cosmic IDE
description: LuaLS code intelligence, Lua project templates, formatting, linting, and LuaRocks workflows.
detailedDescription:
## Lua development

Develop Lua applications and modules with LuaLS intelligence and a practical set of quality tools.

### Features

- Completion, diagnostics, navigation, annotations, and formatting from **LuaLS**
- TextMate syntax highlighting for `.lua` files
- Application and module project templates with LuaLS and StyLua configuration
- Actions for running code, opening a REPL, checking syntax, formatting, and linting
- LuaRocks dependency inspection

### Setup

After installation, run **Install Lua tools** once. Projects with Lua source files or `.luarc.json` configuration are recognized automatically.

name: Python Support
author: Cosmic IDE
description: Python code intelligence, isolated project creation, testing, formatting, linting, and packaging.
detailedDescription:
## Python development

Build Python applications and packages with language intelligence, isolated environments, and focused development workflows.

### Features

- Completion, diagnostics, navigation, hover information, and formatting from **python-lsp-server**
- TextMate syntax highlighting for `.py` and `.pyi` files
- Application and installable-package templates with an automatically created project-local `.venv`
- Context-aware actions for running applications, testing with pytest, formatting and linting with Ruff, and building distributions
- Dependency installation into the project virtual environment when requirements or package metadata are present

### Setup

After installation, run **Install Python tools** once. Existing Python projects are detected from common project files or Python source files.

name: Clangd Support
author: Cosmic IDE
description: Clangd code intelligence for C, C++, Objective-C, Objective-C++, and CUDA sources.
detailedDescription:
## Clangd language support

Edit C-family projects with fast, compiler-aware language intelligence from **clangd**.

### Features

- Completion, diagnostics, navigation, refactoring, signature help, and inlay hints
- C, C++, Objective-C, Objective-C++, and CUDA source and header support
- Background indexing and clang-tidy diagnostics
- Automatic use of `compile_commands.json` supplied by CMake and other build systems

### Setup

After installation, run **Install Clang tools** once. For the most accurate results, configure your build to generate a `compile_commands.json` file.

name: CMake Support
author: Cosmic IDE
description: CMake project templates, automatic detection, and configure, build, run, test, and install workflows.
detailedDescription:
## CMake development

Create, build, and run C or C++ projects with integrated CMake and Make workflows.

### Features

- Automatic detection of projects containing `CMakeLists.txt`
- C and C++ executable or library starter projects
- Debug and release configuration with exported `compile_commands.json`
- Toolbar build-and-run actions for declared executable targets
- Commands for configuring, building, testing, installing, and cleaning projects
- Generated Makefiles through CMake's Unix Makefiles generator

### Setup

After installation, run **Install CMake tools** once. Install Clangd Support separately for C-family code intelligence.

name: Maven Support
author: Cosmic IDE
description: Maven project templates, automatic detection, runnable applications, and comprehensive lifecycle and plugin goals.
detailedDescription:
## Maven development

Create and maintain Maven builds with integrated lifecycle, dependency, plugin, and application workflows.

### Features

- Automatic detection of projects containing `pom.xml`
- Apache Maven archetypes for Java quickstart, simple JAR, and web application projects
- A curated multi-module application template
- Toolbar run actions for detected Java entry points
- Common resolve, build, test, and run commands
- A searchable Maven task picker with lifecycle, dependency, documentation, detected plugin, and configured execution goals
- An interactive **Custom goals…** task for arbitrary Maven goal combinations

### Setup

After installation, run **Install Maven** once. Maven uses Cosmic IDE's selected JDK and downloads archetypes and project dependencies through the repositories configured by the project and Maven settings.

name: Scala Support
author: Cosmic IDE
description: Metals code intelligence, sbt project creation, and Scala build, run, test, and task workflows.
detailedDescription:
## Scala development

Develop Scala projects with Metals code intelligence and integrated build-system workflows.

### Features

- Completion, diagnostics, navigation, refactoring, signature help, and inlay hints from **Metals**
- Scala 2 and Scala 3 syntax highlighting for `.scala`, `.sc`, `.sbt`, and `.mill` files
- Automatic detection of sbt, Mill, Gradle, Maven, Scala CLI, and standard Scala source layouts
- Scala 3 sbt application and library project templates
- Build, run, test, dependency, console, and cleanup commands
- Searchable tasks adapted to the detected Scala build tool

### Setup

After installation, run **Install Scala tools** once. This installs Metals, sbt, and Scala CLI with Coursier into Cosmic IDE's private toolchain.

name: Markdown Support
author: Cosmic IDE
detailedDescription:
## Markdown language support

Edit Markdown documents with real-time diagnostics, document symbols, workspace link validation, and smart auto-completion powered by **markdown-oxide**.

### Features

- Header and link completion
- Workspace link checking
- TextMate syntax highlighting
- Document structure outlines

name: JSON Support
author: Cosmic IDE
detailedDescription:
## JSON language support

Edit JSON and JSONC configuration files with real-time validation, auto-completion, schema validation, and formatting powered by **vscode-json-languageserver**.

### Features

- Auto-completion for properties and values
- Syntax validation and error diagnostics
- Document formatting and folding ranges
- Support for standard JSON, JSONC (with comments), and JSON5

name: Bun Project Support
author: Cosmic IDE
description: Project management, scaffolding, and build support powered by the Bun runtime.
detailedDescription:
## Bun Project Support

Project lifecycle management using **Bun** for ultra-fast package management, scaffolding, and script execution.

### Features

- Bun project recognition (`package.json`, `bun.lock`, `bun.lockb`, `tsconfig.json`, `jsconfig.json`)
- Project scaffolding via `bun create` (Vite, Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, or custom commands)
- Integrated Bun commands (`bun install`, `bun dev`, `bun run build`, `bun start`, `bun test`)

### Setup

Run **Install Bun** to install the runtime via the official install script and upgrade to canary.

name: Vue Language Features
author: Cosmic IDE
description: Language intelligence for Vue Single File Components powered by vue-language-server.
detailedDescription:
## Vue Language Support

Edit `.vue` Single File Components (SFC) with fast language intelligence powered by **vue-language-server**.

### Features

- Intelligent template and script code completion
- Real-time diagnostics and syntax validation
- Go to Definition, References, and Hover help
- Signature Help and Inlay Hints

### Supported Files

- Vue Single File Components (`.vue`)

### Setup

Run **Install Vue Language Server** to install `vue-language-server` via pacman.

name: Android Support
author: Cosmic IDE
description: Android SDK management and build tools integration.
detailedDescription:
## Android Support

Android SDK management and build tools integration for Cosmic IDE.

### Features

- Android SDK status monitoring
- Automated Android SDK and Build Tools installation

### Setup

Run **Install Android SDK** to download and install the Android Command Line Tools and Build Tools 37.0.0.
